payload.reason: The evidence indicates that while various approaches exist for building dialogue systems, including rule-based, hybrid, and end-to-end methods, the reliance on handcrafted rules and features is still prevalent in industrial applications. This suggests that off-the-shelf NLP systems may not be the primary method used for building their assistant, as many systems still depend on manual engineering and domain-specific adaptations.

claims.text: Many industrial dialogue systems still use handcrafted rules and features rather than off-the-shelf NLP systems.
End-to-end systems, while promising, are not yet suitable for commercial conversational agents operating on real-world data.
